scope: Add unmatched-section archive to scripts/preprocess/reorg_by_domain_md.py. Parser B returns (matched, unmatched) tuple. Each unmatched section categorized into one of 4 reasons: false_positive_pattern3, definition_section, real_clause_no_sr, no_clause_id_intro. New write_unmatched_archive() writes one MD per (reg, source_filename) to _archive_unmatched/{REG}/ with YAML-style header (archive_id, source, unmatched_count, categories, generated_by) and verbatim section content prefixed with ## Section N. New write_unmatched_index() creates _archive_unmatched/README.md listing all files with category + source path. Coverage report extended with 'Unmatched archived' section showing per-category breakdown. methodology-00/PREPROCESSING/ remains READ-ONLY. No regression in 38 merged files or in --clean idempotency.

criteria.description: Every archived MD file (in _archive_unmatched/{REG}/) has YAML-style header with archive_id, source, unmatched_count, categories, generated_by (no timestamp).
criteria.test_command:
cd /home/epmq-cyber/Área\ de\ Trabalho/projects/aegis-phase1 && ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -c "
from pathlib import Path
import re
base = Path('methodology-00/PREPROCESSING_by_domain/_archive_unmatched')
files = list(base.glob('*/*.md'))
assert len(files) >= 50, f'Got {len(files)} archive files (expected >=50)'
required_keys = ['archive_id', 'source', 'unmatched_count', 'categories', 'generated_by']
for f in files:
    text = f.read_text()
    for key in required_keys:
        assert f'<!-- {key}:' in text, f'{f.name} missing key {key}'
    # No timestamp (idempotency C16)
    assert not re.search(r'date: \d{4}|timestamp: \d+|generated_at:', text), f'{f.name} has timestamp'
print(f'OK: {len(files)} files, all have 5 required keys + no timestamps')
"
criteria.expected: OK: all archived files have 5 required keys and no timestamps

criteria.description: Verbatim: each section in an archive file matches the corresponding source section byte-for-byte (excluding the '## Section N' prefix the archive adds).
criteria.test_command:
cd /home/epmq-cyber/Área\ de\ Trabalho/projects/aegis-phase1 && ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -c "
import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/preprocess')
from pathlib import Path
import reorg_by_domain_md as m
importlib = __import__('importlib'); importlib.reload(m)
clause_to_subs, article_to_subs = m.parse_clause_to_subs(m.Path('methodology-00/PREPROCESSING'))
matched, unmatched = m.parse_ambiguity_sections(m.Path('methodology-00/PREPROCESSING'), clause_to_subs, article_to_subs)

mismatches = []
for u in unmatched[:50]:  # sample first 50
    src = (m.Path('methodology-00/PREPROCESSING') / 'Regulation' / u['reg'] / 'Ambiguity' / u['file']).read_text()
    src_section = u['section_md']
    # Section content must be substring of source verbatim
    if src_section not in src:
        mismatches.append(f"{u['reg']}/{u['file']}: section_md not found in source")
        if len(mismatches) > 5:
            break
assert not mismatches, f'{len(mismatches)} mismatches: {mismatches[:3]}'
print(f'OK: 50/50 sampled unmatched sections match source verbatim')
"
criteria.expected: OK: 50/50 sampled unmatched sections match source verbatim
